titles.pricesDesc: Prices are updated daily at 6:00 AM as per government guidelines. Quality and density checks are recorded hourly.

titles.servicesDesc: At M.N. Desai Indian Oil, we believe every visit should add value. From pollution checks to exclusive reward points, we offer services that go beyond the pump — because our customers deserve more than just fuel.
titles.testimonialsDesc: Customer satisfaction is our ultimate reward. Read reviews from everyday highway travelers and fleet owners.
titles.contact: Get in Touch & Reach Our Station
titles.contactDesc: Have questions about bulk fuel deals or customized corporate cards? Reach out directly or stop by 24 hours a day.

about.title: IndianOil Petrol Pump (M.N. Desai)
about.description: M N Desai company was established in 1961. During that time one can hardly find a petrol pump on road. M N Desai was dealing in Crude Oil during 1960s. M N Desai was the Petrol Pump between Ahmedabad Bagodra Road during 1970s and 1980s.
about.pureFuelCheck: Daily automated density tests and manual filter paper check options are available to every customer on request.

services.title: PUC and PUC Renewals
services.desc: Stay road-legal without the hassle. Get your pollution certificate tested and renewed on the spot with our government-approved calibrated equipment — fast, accurate, and reliable.

services.title: Electric Recharging
services.desc: The future is electric and we are ready. Our high-speed DC fast charging stations power up your EV quickly and safely, so you are back on the road in no time.

services.title: IOC Rewards Points
services.desc: Every litre you fill earns you more. Collect and redeem Indian Oil loyalty reward points on every transaction at our station — a little something back for your trust.

services.title: Additional Special Rewards Point
services.desc: We like to go the extra mile. Over and above IOC rewards, M.N. Desai offers exclusive special reward points to our valued customers — because loyalty deserves to be celebrated

legacyItems.title: M.N. Desai Indian Oil
legacyItems.desc: M N Desai petrol pump was established in 1961. During that time one can hardly find a petrol pump on road. We started with a strong vision of serving pure fuels.

legacyItems.title: Fuel at Your Doorstep
legacyItems.desc: M.N. Desai Indian Oil brings certified diesel directly to your location — no detours, no delays. Whether it's your fleet, your site, or your doorstep, we deliver quality fuel you can trust, right when you need it.

legacyItems.title: Fuel & Fix on the Go
legacyItems.desc: Stuck on the road? We've got you. M.N. Desai's mobile unit reaches you wherever you are — fuel in the tank, help on the spot.

legacyItems.title: Midnight Run, Full Tank
legacyItems.desc: When the world sleeps, our drivers keep moving. Every night stop at the pump is a promise kept — to the road, to the load, and to the people waiting at the other end.
